# Timm's SelfCitationTextGenerator, patched

`SelfCitationTextGenerator_rules.java` is a modified copy of the main class of Torsten Timm's SelfCitationTextGenerator (https://github.com/TorstenTimm/SelfCitationTextgenerator), released by him under the MIT licence in `LICENSE`. Our changes add four line- and paragraph-position rules used in the generator tests. To build it, clone Timm's repository and replace `SelfCitationTextGenerator.java` in package `de.voynich.text` with this file; the helper classes in `de.voynich.text.util` come from his repository unchanged.
